settings.title: Understanding Air Filters: Breathe Easy With The Right Choice

settings.editor:
Air filters come in various types, each with its own strengths and weaknesses. Here's a breakdown of the most common options:

  • Fiberglass Filters: These are the most basic and affordable filters. While they capture larger dust particles, they're ineffective against allergens and smaller pollutants.
  • Pleated Air Filters: These offer improved filtration compared to fiberglass. They're constructed with pleated material that increases surface area, capturing more dust and allergens.
  • HEPA Filters: High-Efficiency Particulate Air filters are the gold standard for air purification. They trap up to 99.97% of airborne particles as small as 0.3 microns, including bacteria, dust, pollen, and pet dander.

Unsure which filter is suitable for your home? Contact our experienced technicians today and we will assess your needs and recommend the optimal solution for cleaner, healthier air.

settings.title: Frequently Asked Questions: Air Filters Demystified

settings.editor: We understand you might have questions about air filters. Here are some frequently asked questions to help you make an informed decision:

tabs.tab_title: How Often Should I Change My Air Filter?
tabs.tab_content: The recommended frequency depends on the filter type, your home environment, and whether you have pets. Generally, fiberglass filters need replacing every 1-3 months, pleated filters every 2-3 months, and HEPA filters every 6-12 months.

tabs.tab_title: Where Is My Air Filter Located?
tabs.tab_content: Most air filters are located within your HVAC system. Common locations include the furnace or air handler unit.

tabs.tab_title: Can I Install An Air Filter Myself?
tabs.tab_content: While some air filters are easy to replace, for optimal performance, it's recommended to have a professional handle the installation. Our technicians ensure the filter is properly sized and fitted for your system, maximizing its effectiveness.

tabs.tab_title: What Size Air Filter Do I Need?
tabs.tab_content: Air filters come in various sizes. Improperly sized filters won't function correctly and could damage your HVAC system. Magnolia Air's technicians can accurately measure and recommend the perfect air filter size for your unit.

tabs.tab_title: Are There Any Additional Benefits To Using A HEPA Filter?
tabs.tab_content: HEPA filters not only trap allergens and pollutants, but they can also help reduce airborne bacteria and viruses. This is particularly beneficial for families with young children or those with compromised immune systems.
